posts.body_html: I usually get good fall pitchers on my leuco's and have some nice ones this year, but the alba and HCW ones never seem to produce the white I was looking for when I got them. It could be the clones I have though. I do get better pitchers both spring and fall the years we have a warm spring, but it varies from year to year depending on how much sun we get and when.

posts.body_html:
HCW clone A is definitely one of the top 3 choice clones from the original, authentic hurricane creek white clones in existence. Can't top Bristol's plant pictured above in terms of color, but this just goes to show the plant can perform very well when given decent care. Photos taken 10/3/18:




Maybe that pink blush we see in AxF crosses come predominantly from clone A:




Nice sized trap on clone A this year:



Now here's the same traps a few days later. They certainly did turn whiter, but we had a heat wave that fried everything, so this is the best I was able to photograph this year:




A few days after this trap opened up, I punched it (accidently) a few times with my leg while walking by. That explains the scar in the middle of the trap...and no, the plant didn't fall down the stairs.... Given the suspicious signs of abuse, I didn't want the PPS (Plant Protective Services) being called on me, but I'm confident my alibi for the physical abuse checks out:
